title: Decision Support System (BIT30303)
description: UTHM BIT30303 Decision Support System: practice questions, lessons and a decision lab built from the lecture slides and the past-year finals. Chapter 1 pilot — what a DSS is, its three components, Power's five types, and how decisions and information systems sit across the management levels.

lab.label: Decision lab
lab.note: Fill the gaps in summary tables of DSS components, types and decision categories. Most gaps are dropdowns; a typed gap needs the term spelled as the slides write it, because a differently worded but equivalent answer may not be recognized.
